business_summary: Zanyu Technology Group Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research and development, manufacture, and sale of surfactants and oleo chemicals and personal care products in China and internationally. The company offers anionic surfactants, including sodium and ammonium lauryl ether sulfate, sodium and ammonium lauryl sulfate, sodium alpha-olefin sulfonate, and dodecyl benzenesulfonic acid products; nonionic surfactants, such as coconut monoethanolamide, fatty acid diethanolamide, primary alcohol ethoxylate, and alkyl polyglucosides products; and amphoteric surfactants comprising cocamidopropy betaine and cocamidopropyl amine oxide products, as well as liquid sodium silicate products. It also provides oleochemicals, including hydrogenated oil, fatty acid, fatty acid ester, glycerin, stearate, dimer acid/polyamide resin, and monoacid products; and OEM/ODM cleaning and care products comprising antibacterial hand sanitizer OEM / ODM custom processing; factory wholesale dishwashing liquid with custom packaging for kitchen use; fruit and vegetable cleaner OEM / ODM customized processing; kitchen degreaser OEM / ODM customized processing; liquid laundry detergent; premium detergent powder for OEM and ODM products. The company was formerly known as Zhejiang Zanyu Technology Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Zanyu Technology Group Co., Ltd. in November 2016. Zanyu Technology Group Co., Ltd. was founded in 1965 and is headquartered in Hangzhou, China.
